lines.text: [excited] Fourteen S, eight P. Sounds like a Wi-Fi password, right? Let's decode it!
S means series. Fourteen cells at three point six volts... fifty point four volts.
P means parallel. Eight cells of three and a half amp-hours... twenty-eight amp-hours.
Current adds up in parallel too. Eight times ten amps... eighty amps.
The whole pack? A hundred and twelve cells. About one point four kilowatt-hours.
[excited] So what's YOUR pack code? Drop it in the comments!
